name: Click Snap
description: Records where you click on completed runs. If you click slightly early next time, the click is held back and fired at the recorded spot.

window.name: Early window (units)
window.description: How far ahead of a recorded click (in game units, 30 = 1 block) an early press gets delayed.

deathTrim.name: Death trim (units)
deathTrim.description: When you die, clicks within this distance before the death are discarded (the mistimed click that killed you). Everything earlier is kept.
